source_refs.note: Topic 2.2.1.2 Variable Naming Rules (PDF 36, printed 33). MCQ 3 is answered (printed options 'variablel' and 'Ivariable' read as variable1 and 1variable).

items: The name must begin with a letter (a-z, A-Z) or an underscore (_).
Later characters can be letters, digits (0-9) or underscores.
Names are case-sensitive: age and Age are two different variables.
Python's reserved keywords, such as for, while and if, cannot be used as variable names.

blocks.text: Always use meaningful names (age instead of a). It is good practice to use lowercase letters with underscores between words, such as student_name; this style is called snake_case. Strings in Python are always enclosed in quotes, single (' ') or double (" ").
